kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أبتسم (form VIII)
# أَبْتَسِمُ (ʔabtasimu) /ʔab.ta.si.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَسَمَ (ibtasama)
# أَبْتَسِمَ (ʔabtasima) /ʔab.ta.si.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَسَمَ (ibtasama)
# أَبْتَسِمْ (ʔabtasim) /ʔab.ta.sim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِبْتَسَمَ (ibtasama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
